<div style="max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto;">
<div style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d1319,#10202e); border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:16px; padding:22px 24px; margin-bottom:16px;">
<div style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase;">Twitch Chat Game</div>
<div style="color:#e6edf3; font-size:28px; font-weight:800; margin:4px 0 6px;">Deviation Hunt</div>
<div style="color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">A Once Human catching game that lives in Twitch chat. While a stream is live, deviations are spotted in the wild in chat — type <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!secure</nowiki></span> to catch them, collect all 61 deviations with their variations and skins, and roll the best Skill Rating, Activity Rating and traits. Your Deviation Bag follows you to '''every''' channel that runs the game.</div>
<div style="margin-top:12px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;">
<span style="background:#0ea5e9; border-radius:8px; padding:6px 14px; font-weight:700;">[https://ohdeviationhunt-production.up.railway.app <span style="color:#04121c;">Add it to your channel</span>]</span>
<span style="background:#131c27; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:8px; padding:6px 14px; font-weight:700;">[https://ohdeviationhunt-production.up.railway.app/top <span style="color:#e6edf3;">Leaderboard</span>]</span>
<span style="background:#131c27; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:8px; padding:6px 14px; font-weight:700;">[[Deviation_Main_Page|<span style="color:#e6edf3;">Deviation database</span>]]</span>
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Start</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">How to Play</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
# Watch a stream that has '''ohdeviationhunt''' in chat.
# When the bot posts ''"👀 A … has been spotted in the wild!"'', type <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!secure</nowiki></span> within '''90 seconds'''.
# When the timer ends the bot posts who secured it, along with each new specimen's Skill and Activity Rating.
# Check your collection any time with <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!deviationbag</nowiki></span> or on your own page: <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>https://ohdeviationhunt-production.up.railway.app/u/</nowiki>''yourname''</span>

Your first <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!secure</nowiki></span> signs you up automatically — you start with '''5 Securement Units''' and '''200 Starchrom'''. Every <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!secure</nowiki></span> uses one Securement Unit whether it catches or not, and you get one throw per spawn.
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Chat</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">List of All Commands</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; background:#0f1620; color:#cfd6df; border:1px solid #1f2a35; margin-top:10px;"
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Command
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Effect
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!secure</nowiki></span> || Throw a Securement Unit at the deviation that's loose in chat. Also works as <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!catch</nowiki></span>. One throw per person per spawn.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!units</nowiki></span> || Show your Securement Units, Starchrom, and when your next free unit arrives. Also <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!inv</nowiki></span>.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!shop</nowiki></span> || Show what the shop sells and the prices. The Deviation Bag panel has the same shop in its '''Shop''' tab.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!buy <amount></nowiki></span> || Buy Securement Units for 500 Starchrom each, e.g. <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!buy 2</nowiki></span>.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!daily</nowiki></span> || Claim your daily supply drop: +100 Starchrom and 1 Securement Unit, and turn on 1 free Securement Unit every hour for the rest of the day while you're in a live stream. '''Once a day''' — resets at midnight Central time — and only during a live stream.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!deviationbag [name]</nowiki></span> || Your collection count (unique deviations, variants & skins) and a link to your collection page. Add a name to see someone else's.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!traits <deviation></nowiki></span> || Skill Rating, Activity Rating and all three traits of your best specimen of that deviation. Also <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!stats</nowiki></span>.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!dev <deviation></nowiki></span> || Info about a deviation: what it does, its variations and skins, and a wiki link.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!scrap</nowiki></span> || Recycle every duplicate for Starchrom (50% of its catch reward). You keep the specimen with the best Skill + Activity Rating of each deviation and variant.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunttop</nowiki></span> || Top collectors across every channel. Also <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!leaderboard</nowiki></span>.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt</nowiki></span> || Short help message with a link to this guide.
|}
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Mods</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">Streamer & Moderator Commands</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
Only the broadcaster and moderators can use these.
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; background:#0f1620; color:#cfd6df; border:1px solid #1f2a35; margin-top:10px;"
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Command
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Effect
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt spawn</nowiki></span> || Spawn a deviation right now.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt interval <minutes></nowiki></span> || How often deviations appear while you're live (2–120 minutes, default 7).
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt off</nowiki></span> / <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt on</nowiki></span> || Pause or resume spawns. Other commands keep working.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt status</nowiki></span> || Live status, spawn timer, what's loose, and this channel's spawn/catch totals.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt leave</nowiki></span> || Remove the bot from your channel.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt help</nowiki></span> || List the mod commands in chat.
|}
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Shop</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">Securement Units</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
Securement Units are the only thing you need to catch deviations — there is one kind, and it works on everything.
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; background:#0f1620; color:#cfd6df; border:1px solid #1f2a35; margin-top:10px;"
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Item
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Description
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Price
|-
| '''Securement Unit''' || Catches one deviation. Used up on every <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!secure</nowiki></span>, caught or not. || 500 Starchrom
|}

'''Ways to get Securement Units'''
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; background:#0f1620; color:#cfd6df; border:1px solid #1f2a35; margin-top:10px;"
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Source
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Amount
|-
| Starting supply || 5 units
|-
| Free hourly unit || +1 unit every hour after you claim today's <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!daily</nowiki></span>, while you're in a live stream running the game (the one where you last used a game command). '''One stream at a time''' — watching several doesn't earn more, and the timer keeps running when you switch streams. The bot tells you in chat each time one arrives.
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!daily</nowiki></span> || +1 unit, once a day (resets at midnight Central)
|-
| Destroying an extra specimen in the Twitch panel || +1 unit (plus 500 Starchrom)
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!buy <amount></nowiki></span> or the panel's '''Shop''' tab || 500 Starchrom each
|}
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Currency</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">Starchrom</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
Starchrom is earned by securing deviations and spent on Securement Units.
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; background:#0f1620; color:#cfd6df; border:1px solid #1f2a35; margin-top:10px;"
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | How
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Starchrom
|-
| Securing a deviation || <span style="color:#9fb0c0; font-weight:800;">Common</span> 10 · <span style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:800;">Uncommon</span> 20 · <span style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:800;">Rare</span> 40 · <span style="color:#c084fc; font-weight:800;">Epic</span> 80 · <span style="color:#fbbf24; font-weight:800;">Legendary</span> 200
|-
| Securing a Variation || ×2 the normal reward
|-
| Securing a Skin || 200
|-
| First time you secure a deviation (or a new variant of it) || +100 bonus
|-
| A throw that misses || +3 salvage
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!daily</nowiki></span> || +100
|-
| <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!scrap</nowiki></span> || 50% of the catch reward per duplicate
|-
| Destroying an extra specimen in the Twitch panel || +500 each, plus 1 Securement Unit back (only while you own more than one)
|}
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Odds</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">Spawn Rates & Capture Rates</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
Each spawn first rolls a rarity, then a deviation of that rarity. Everyone who throws gets their own roll — any number of people can secure the same deviation.
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; background:#0f1620; color:#cfd6df; border:1px solid #1f2a35; margin-top:10px;"
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Rarity
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Spawn chance
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Capture rate
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Capture rate (Variation)
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Starchrom reward
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Deviations
|-
| <span style="color:#9fb0c0; font-weight:800;">Common</span> || 40% || 70% || 59.5% || 10 || 26
|-
| <span style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:800;">Uncommon</span> || 28% || 55% || 46.8% || 20 || 19
|-
| <span style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:800;">Rare</span> || 18% || 40% || 34% || 40 || 9
|-
| <span style="color:#c084fc; font-weight:800;">Epic</span> || 10% || 25% || 21.3% || 80 || 4
|-
| <span style="color:#fbbf24; font-weight:800;">Legendary</span> || 4% || 12% || 10.2% || 200 || 3
|}

* '''Variations''' spawn about 8.3% of the time (on deviations that have them). They are 15% harder to secure and pay ×2 Starchrom.
* '''Skins''' spawn about 2.5% of the time (on deviations that have them). Every skin counts as <span style="color:#fbbf24; font-weight:800;">Legendary</span> with a flat '''9%''' capture rate.
* Capture rates never go above 95%.
</div>
</div>

<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Shiny</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">Variations & Skins</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
Variations and skins are Deviation Hunt's shinies. When one appears, the spawn message says so:
<span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;">👀 A Grumpy Bulb has been spotted in the wild! ✨ VARIATION: Violet Robe Type !secure within 90s to catch it.</span>

* Each variation and skin is its own entry in your Deviation Bag, and the first one of each earns the +100 new-entry bonus.
* On your collection page and in the Twitch panel, caught variations glow '''<span style="color:#fbbf24;">gold</span>''' and caught skins glow '''<span style="color:#f472b6;">pink</span>''', showing the variant's picture.
* Some deviations have a trait that belongs to one variant only (e.g. Grumpy Bulb's Slot 1 trait is ''Violet Robe'') — see Traits below.
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Ratings</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">Skill Rating & Activity Rating</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
Every deviation you secure is its own specimen with two ratings from 1 to 5 — '''Skill Rating''' (Deviant Power) and '''Activity Rating''' (Mood). Higher is rarer:
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; background:#0f1620; color:#cfd6df; border:1px solid #1f2a35; margin-top:10px;"
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Rating
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | 1
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | 2
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | 3
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | 4
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | 5
|-
| Chance || 30% || 28% || 22% || 13% || 7%
|}

A 5/5 specimen gets a ⭐ in chat. Catch the same deviation again to hunt for better ratings — <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!scrap</nowiki></span> always keeps your best one.
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Traits</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">Traits</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
Each specimen has three trait slots, and '''each slot may or may not have a trait''' — so a specimen can have none, one, two or all three. Filled slots follow the exact rules of the [[Deviation_Trait_Page|Deviation Trait Page]], for the deviation's own category (combat, crafting or territory):
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; background:#0f1620; color:#cfd6df; border:1px solid #1f2a35; margin-top:10px;"
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Slot
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | Chance of a trait
! style="background:#131c27; color:#e6edf3; text-align:left;" | What it can roll
|-
| '''Slot 1''' || 60% || Any Global trait (with a random level), or — sometimes — that deviation's own Slot 1 trait.
|-
| '''Slot 2''' || 50% || Any general Slot 2 trait of its category, or — sometimes — one of that deviation's own Slot 2 traits. Another deviation's own trait can never appear.
|-
| '''Slot 3''' || 40% || Any Slot 3 (fused) trait of its category.
|}

* A deviation's own traits that belong to a specific variation or skin only ever appear on that variant — and that variant always carries it, so its slot is never empty.
* Own traits that aren't tied to a variant can appear on any specimen of that deviation.
* See any specimen's traits with <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!traits <deviation></nowiki></span>, on your collection page, or in the Twitch panel.
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Collection</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">Deviation Bag & Twitch Panel</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
Your collection is tied to your Twitch account, not to a channel — everything you catch on any stream lands in the same Deviation Bag, and a name change doesn't lose it.

* '''Collection page:''' <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>https://ohdeviationhunt-production.up.railway.app/u/</nowiki>''yourname''</span> — every deviation grouped by Combat / Crafting / Territory, your best specimen's ratings and traits, and caught variations and skins highlighted. <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!deviationbag</nowiki></span> posts your link.
* '''Twitch panel:''' the ''Deviation Bag'' panel extension shows your own collection under the stream on any channel that installs it. Click '''Show my Deviation Bag''' once to let Twitch share your username with it. Click a deviation to see '''every''' specimen you own with its Skill Rating, Activity Rating and traits — when you have more than one, you can destroy an extra for '''500 Starchrom + 1 Securement Unit''' (you always keep at least one). Switch to the '''Shop''' tab to buy Securement Units with your Starchrom without typing in chat. ''The panel is in testing and will be installable by every streamer once Twitch approves it.''
* '''Leaderboard:''' [https://ohdeviationhunt-production.up.railway.app/top ohdeviationhunt-production.up.railway.app/top] or <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunttop</nowiki></span>.
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">Streamers</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">Add Deviation Hunt to Your Channel</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
# Go to [https://ohdeviationhunt-production.up.railway.app ohdeviationhunt-production.up.railway.app] and click '''Add to my channel''' (sign in with Twitch). Or type <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!join</nowiki></span> in [https://www.twitch.tv/ohdeviationhunt ohdeviationhunt's chat].
# If the bot says it needs permission, type <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>/mod ohdeviationhunt</nowiki></span> in your chat and try again.
# That's it. Deviations appear about every '''7 minutes''' while you're '''live''' and someone has chatted in the last 10 minutes. Change the timer with <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt interval <minutes></nowiki></span>.

To remove it, type <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt leave</nowiki></span> in your chat or <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!leave</nowiki></span> in ohdeviationhunt's chat.
</div>
</div>


<div class="pn-box" style="background:#0d1319; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:16px 18px;">
<span style="color:#0ea5e9; font-weight:800;">FAQ</span>
<span style="font-weight:700; color:#e6edf3; font-size:16px; flex:1;">Frequently Asked Questions</span>
</div>
<div style="padding:14px 20px 18px; border-top:1px solid #1f2a35; color:#cfd6df; line-height:1.7;">
'''Q: How do I start?'''<br>A: Just type <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!secure</nowiki></span> the next time a deviation shows up. Your first throw signs you up with 5 Securement Units and 200 Starchrom.

'''Q: I typed !secure and the bot didn't answer.'''<br>A: That's normal — the bot stays quiet so chat isn't spammed. Results for everyone are posted when the 90-second window ends. It only replies right away if you're out of units.

'''Q: Why wasn't my name in the result?'''<br>A: Only the people who secured it are listed. If your name isn't there, it broke free from your unit (you still get +3 Starchrom).

'''Q: I'm out of Securement Units.'''<br>A: Claim <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!daily</nowiki></span> during a live stream: you get 1 right away and 1 free every hour for the rest of the day while you're in a live stream. Or <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!buy <amount></nowiki></span> for 500 Starchrom each. <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!units</nowiki></span> shows when the next free one arrives.

'''Q: Do better units exist?'''<br>A: No — there's a single Securement Unit. Your odds depend only on the deviation's rarity and whether it's a variation or skin.

'''Q: Does my collection carry over between channels?'''<br>A: Yes. It's tied to your Twitch account and shared across every channel running Deviation Hunt.

'''Q: Why aren't deviations spawning?'''<br>A: They only appear while the stream is live and chat has been active in the last 10 minutes. A mod may also have used <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt off</nowiki></span> — <span style="background:#131c27; color:#7dd3fc; border:1px solid #1f2a35; border-radius:6px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;"><nowiki>!hunt status</nowiki></span> shows what's going on.

'''Q: Where do the deviations, traits and pictures come from?'''<br>A: Straight from this wiki — the [[Deviation_Main_Page|Deviation database]] and [[Deviation_Trait_Page|Deviation Trait Page]]. When the wiki is updated, the game picks it up within a few hours.
